title: etcd v3 RPC error types
version: etcd API v3 rpctypes source; accessed 2026-11-27.
locator: ErrGRPCInvalidAuthToken uses gRPC Unauthenticated; ErrGRPCPermissionDenied uses PermissionDenied; ErrGRPCNoLeader/LeaderChanged/Stopped/Timeout use Unavailable.
notes: Used to distinguish identity/authorization failures from cluster availability failures. Source branch may advance; deployed live test version is etcd v3.7.0.
